question: Can a persistent sparse causal program learn previously unnamed Boolean compositions from do-consequences and improve nuisance-shift transfer over a conventional fully fitted SAME-LIBRARY ElasticNet, fresh OMP and softmax-memory controls, while retaining its old head?

design.generator: E61:v1 SHA256 keyed. Ten causal bits; two correlated/anticorrelated nuisance observed bits. Hidden XOR(AND,AND), AND(XOR,XOR), and 5-variable conditional gate; one shared factor + one changed stage-specific. Gaussian observation noise sigma .18; planted identities withheld.
design.learner_feature_bank: 12,012 authored AND/XOR pair and depth-two compositions on 12 observed variables; factor labels and planted supports withheld but primitive grammar PROVIDED; conditional 5-variable structure is outside maximum representation depth.
design.candidate: Old four-term greedy sparse/ridge checkpoint. Preserve its OLD readout exactly; carry two OLD terms and fit two NEW residual-selected terms, using NEW 80 witnessed labels. NEW model scores NEW and COLD; OLD checkpoint scores OLD.
fully_trained_controls: fresh_full_bank_omp: four terms on same 12012 bank
pooled_full_bank_omp: four terms old+new on same bank
fresh_composition_elasticnet: alpha .045 L1 .8 max_iter2000 tol1e-3 same 12012 bank
fresh_poly_elasticnet: fourth-degree polynomial input alpha .05 L1 .8 max_iter2500 tol1e-3
softmax_old_fresh: conventional train-error-weighted old/fresh OMP snapshot mixture temperature .17
negatives: shuffled_new (same program search on permuted NEW labels)
design.observation_parity: All methods see exactly the same 80 OLD and 80 NEW witnessed data. Some conventional controls use only NEW by design. Candidate and controls differ in model capacity and compute; no fair-compute superiority claims.
design.source_generator_audit: Independent scorer and auditor source files with separately authored world reconstruction, greedy refitting and all conventional model refits; same underlying NumPy/scikit-learn solvers. Full original predictions and interventions required.
design.runtime: Local single-thread CPU Python 3.13, numpy2.3.5, scipy1.17.0, sklearn1.8.0. One screen, single unchanged-source replay and independent audit. No paid API or official runner, controller or scheduler.
design.metric: Per-world noisy held MSE on 64 disjoint old/new/cold interventions; pooled across 12 worlds, per seed and per mechanism family. Lower is better. Model compute timing is separate from whole process.

gates.cold_best: candidate cold pooled MSE <= .95 * best pooled mean of fresh_full_bank_omp,pooled_full_bank_omp,fresh_poly_elasticnet,fresh_composition_elasticnet,fresh_extra_trees,fresh_hgb,fresh_rbf_krr,softmax_old_fresh
gates.seed_both: candidate per-seed cold MSE STRICTLY lower than best competing method in both unseen seeds
gates.family_at_most_10pct_worse: candidate cold MSE <=1.10 * same-bank ElasticNet within each of 3 unseen causal families
gates.cold_new_ratio: candidate pooled cold MSE <=1.25 * candidate pooled NEW held MSE
gates.old_exact: candidate historical OLD predictions exactly equal old_no_update old checkpoint for EVERY case; 0 tolerance

decision.SCREEN_PROMISING: Critical cold_best,cold_same_bank_elasticnet,cold_same_bank_omp,cold_softmax,seed_both,old_exact all PASS plus at least 9/10 total and independent auditor PASS. Only then optionally run separately frozen primary.
decision.SCREEN_NO_GO: Any critical gate fails OR fewer than 9/10 gates pass with sound source, held split and independent audit. Preserve negative outcomes; DO NOT consume primary seeds.
decision.INVALID: Evidence generated before GitHub source/prereg, source hash drift, held-label/hidden-structure leakage, missing fully trained controls, non-unique causal assignments, broken independent auditor, missing original receipts. Never misclassify INVALID as scientific negative.
decision.UNVERIFIED: Primary/screen or audit incomplete. No success/failure claim.

prohibitions: No tuning consumed screen seeds, weights, gates or extra post-hoc seeds
No accepted ref, runtime model weights, native Yggdrasil owner, research loop, controller, queue, runner, merge, deployment or scientific first-use
No claims of autonomous unrestricted operator invention or intelligence from researcher-supplied finite primitive basis
smoke_disclosure: Excluded seed 999001, 3 worlds, evaluated before freeze and negative vs matched ElasticNet. Exactly 21603 audit assertions PASS. Fresh seeds 103301/103319 NEVER evaluated at prereg.
